title: Articuno Holo Rare 144/165 NM Pokémon Scarlet & Violet 151
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Articuno card is a must-have for any Pokémon collector or player. With a water attribute and holo rare finish, it's a powerful addition to any deck. The card features the legendary creature Articuno and is part of the Scarlet & Violet set.

It's a standard size card made of high-quality card stock material, manufactured by Nintendo in Japan. The card number is 144/165 and it's a basic stage Pokémon card. The card is in Japanese language and is suitable for ages 4 and up. Don't miss out on the chance to add this rare and sought-after card to your collection.
